License:  Only available in  TouchDesigner Educational ,  TouchDesigner Commercial  and  TouchDesigner Pro .
The Leuze ROD4  CHOP  connects to the  Leuze ROD4  laser scanner via TCP/IP. Blob Tracking mode allows for turning the measured distances into blobs for use as an interaction surface. It should work with any of the ROD4 scanners currently available.
The 'object detection' mode available on some of the models is not currently supported.
The Leuze can be used with the  Blob Track CHOP  to detect objects in its field. See the OP Snippet for Blob Track.

parameters.label: Active
parameters.name: active
parameters.description: While on, the  CHOP  receives information from the scanner. While off, the network connection is disconnected and no updating occurs.

parameters.label: Network Address
parameters.name: netaddress
parameters.description: The IP address of the ROD4 scanner.

parameters.label: Network Port
parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The network port of the scanner.

parameters.label: ROD4 Protocol
parameters.name: rod4porotocol
parameters.description: ⊞  - Selects which protocol to use. This must match the protocol the scanner was set to use in the RODplussoft setup utility for the device. You may still get some sort of data if the wrong protocol is selected, but the data will be random and incorrect.

parameters.label: ROD4plus ASCII
parameters.description: Remote   ascii  -

parameters.label: Input Coordinate
parameters.name: inputcoordinate
parameters.description: ⊞  - Available when using ROD4plus ASCII-Remote protocol, specifies whether to use Polar or Cartesian input coordinates. This must match the coordinate the scanner was set to use in the RODplussoft setup utility for the device.

parameters.label: Output Mode
parameters.name: outputmode
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select Raw Data or Blob Tracking mode for output channels. The parameters below are only available in Blob Tracking mode.

parameters.label: Raw Data
parameters.name: rawdata
parameters.description: A  CHOP  of 529 samples long that will contain the raw X/Y position in meters of every measured point from the scanner.

parameters.label: Blob Tracking
parameters.name: blobtracking
parameters.description: The raw data will be analyzed for points that are close together which will be turned into blobs and assigned unique IDs.

parameters.label: Max Blobs
parameters.name: maxblobs
parameters.description: The maximum number of blobs that can be tracked.

parameters.label: Max Point Distance in Blob
parameters.name: maxpointdistance
parameters.description: Two measured points from the scanner are considered to be part of the same blob if they are this distance or closer to each other. Distance is specified in meters.

parameters.label: Max Blob Movement
parameters.name: maxblobmovement
parameters.description: Specified in meters. This controls the maximum distance a blob can move between successive frames and still be considered the same 'blob'.

parameters.label: Area of Interest
parameters.name: areaofinterest
parameters.description: ⊞  - Limits the area in which blobs are tracked.

parameters.label: Off
parameters.name: off
parameters.description: No limitations, blobs tracked throughout the scanned area.

parameters.label: Distance Based
parameters.name: distancebased
parameters.description: Blobs only tracked within specified distance from the scanner.

parameters.label: Bounding Box
parameters.name: boundingbox
parameters.description: Blobs only tracked within specified bounding box.

parameters.label: Max Distance
parameters.name: maxdistance
parameters.description: Maximum distance in which blobs are tracked when Area of Interest parameter is set to Distance Based.

parameters.label: Lower Left Corner
parameters.name: lowerleft
parameters.description: ⊞  - Specifies the lower left corner of the bounding box used when Area of Interest parameter is set to Bounding Box.

parameters.label: Upper Right Corner
parameters.name: upperright
parameters.description: ⊞  - Specifies the upper right corner of the bounding box used when Area of Interest parameter is set to Bounding Box.

parameters.label: Allow Movement Outside Area
parameters.name: allowmovementoutside
parameters.description: When this is on, blobs detected within the Area of Interest can move outside of that area and still be tracked. When this is off blobs that move outside the area of interest will stop being tracked.

parameters.label: Bounding Box Mask  TOP
parameters.name: boundingboxmask
parameters.description: Specify a  TOP  to use as a mask for the bounding box when Area of Interest parameter is set to Bounding Box. Any pixel with a non-zero value will be treated as part of the area of interest, any pixel that is (0,0,0) will be treated as not in the area of interest. Regardless of resolution/aspect ratio of the  TOP , the  TOP  will be stretched to fix the bounding box specified. This  TOP  should  not  be cooking every frame as that will make the ROD4  CHOP  very slow.

parameters.label: Rotate Incoming Coordinates
parameters.name: rotate
parameters.description: Rotates all incoming coordinates where the tx and ty values are rotated around a perpendicular z-axis.

parameters.label: Time Slice
parameters.name: timeslice
parameters.description: Turning this on forces the channels to be " Time Sliced ".  A  Time Slice  is the time between the last cook frame and the current cook frame.

parameters.label: Scope
parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: To determine which channels get affected, some CHOPs use a  Scope  string on the Common page.

parameters.label: Sample Rate  Match
parameters.name: srselect
parameters.description: ⊞  - Handle cases where multiple input CHOPs' sample rates are different. When Resampling occurs, the curves are interpolated according to the Interpolation Method Option, or "Linear" if the Interpolate Options are not available.

parameters.label: Resample At First Input's Rate
parameters.name: first
parameters.description: Use rate of first input to resample others.

parameters.label: Resample At Maximum Rate
parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Resample to the highest sample rate.

parameters.label: Resample At Minimum Rate
parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Resample to the lowest sample rate.

parameters.label: Error If Rates Differ
parameters.name: err
parameters.description: Doesn't accept conflicting sample rates.

parameters.label: Export  Method
parameters.name: exportmethod
parameters.description: ⊞  - This will determine how to connect the  CHOP  channel to the parameter. Refer to the  Export  article for more information.

parameters.label: DAT  Table by Index
parameters.name: datindex
parameters.description: Uses the docked  DAT  table and references the channel via the index of the channel in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: DAT  Table by Name
parameters.name: datname
parameters.description: Uses the docked  DAT  table and references the channel via the name of the channel in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: Channel Name is  Path : Parameter
parameters.name: autoname
parameters.description: The channel is the full destination of where to export to, such has  geo1/transform1:tx .

parameters.label: Export   Root
parameters.name: autoexportroot
parameters.description: This path points to the root node where all of the paths that exporting by  Channel Name is  Path : Parameter   are relative to.

parameters.label: Export  Table
parameters.name: exporttable
parameters.description: The  DAT  used to hold the export information when using the  DAT  Table  Export  Methods (See above).

parameters.label: start
parameters.description: Start of the  CHOP  interval in samples.

parameters.label: length
parameters.description: Number of samples in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: sample_rate
parameters.description: The samplerate of the channels in frames per second.

parameters.label: num_channels
parameters.description: Number of channels in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: time_slice
parameters.description: 1 if  CHOP  is  Time Slice  enabled, 0 otherwise.

parameters.label: export_sernum
parameters.description: A count of how often the export connections have been updated.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.

parameters.label: samples
parameters.description: per-second of a  CHOP . Each CHOP in your network has a sample rate. In contrast, the overall timeline has a  Frame Rate , which is the number of frames to  cook  and display per second, generally your monitor display frequency, default 60.

parameters.label: An  Operator Family  that manipulates text strings: multi
parameters.description: line text or tables. Multi-line text is often a python  Script  or  GLSL  Shader, but can be any multi-line text.  Tables  are rows and columns of cells, each containing a text string.

parameters.label: TouchDesigner is a hierarchy of components. "root" is the top
parameters.description: most network in the hierarchy. The  Network Path  or Path for root is simply  / . A typical path is  /project1/moviein1 .
